collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE X: GROWING UP, GROWING OLD AND EVERYDAY JOY (LCJ-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
The rest of the owner's 100 Living Culture ideas and the world-inspired 50: secret languages and forgotten words, coming of age, elders who will not retire, healers' oaths, failed discoveries, masks and clothes and masterpieces nobody wanted, talent shows, ridiculous hats and the day nobody worked.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A hat contest has broken out at the festival: judge the hats, or just wear them.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: It started when (subject) wore a hat made of a whole palm frond, and (friend) answered with one made of three coconuts and a crab. Now the whole festival has turned into a hat contest, and someone is building a hat with a small canoe on top. What should happen?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The judging is chaos. The canoe hat wins, then falls off its wearer's head into the fire. The crab escapes from (friend)'s hat and pinches a judge. The festival of hats becomes a yearly event.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: Nobody judges. Everyone just wears ridiculous hats for the rest of the night. In the morning, the beach is covered in abandoned hats, and the children wear them for a week.
